title: New server, more memory, comics are fixed
author: emulsifier
html: It will still probably crash when reddit shines it’s deathray in our direction, but hey comments are back at least.
postClass: post-892 post type-post status-publish format-standard hentry category-news uentry post-blog postonpage-1 odd post-author-emulsifier

comments.author: tr8
comments.html:
I’d guess that you need a CDN and caching much more than you need a beefier server. Even something free like CloudFlare and a simple nginx cache directive would probably make a massive difference.

/unsolicited advice

comments.author: emulsifier
comments.html: Oh hey thanks, I had no idea that there were free CDN providers. Setting up now, thanks.

comments.author: Katze
comments.html: Hey, Emulsifier, I don’t know if you handle everything about the website.. but I wanted to mention to someone; the link to the “first” comic is identical to the link to the current/latest comic! There is no easy way to get to the first one to read the comics in order.. even in changing the URL, the very beginning isn’t ?p=1. I clicked through hundreds and eventually made it there, but it was very frustrating and might put new viewers off!

comments.author: The Lurker
comments.html: Sorry for linking to the site on reddit. Someone posted one of your comics without crediting you so I just mentioned akimbocomics in the comments.
